column2:
rabbit(n.)兔子
(無詞性變化)
pet rabbit 寵物兔
white rabbit 白兔
My sister has a cute pet rabbit.
(我妹妹養了一隻可愛的寵物兔。)
The rabbit is eating a carrot.
(那隻兔子正在吃紅蘿蔔。)

race(n./v.)賽跑、比賽、種族
racer(n.)賽跑者、賽車手
racial(adj.)種族的
win a race 贏得比賽
human race 人類
Tom won the race at school today.
(湯姆今天在學校贏得了賽跑。)
Let's race to the park!
(我們來比賽跑到公園吧！)

radio(n./v.)收音機、廣播、用無線電通訊
(無詞性變化)
listen to the radio 聽廣播
radio station 廣播電台
My dad listens to the radio every morning.
(我爸爸每天早上聽廣播。)
I heard the news on the radio.
(我在廣播上聽到這則新聞。)

rain(n./v.)雨、下雨
rainy(adj.)下雨的
heavy rain 大雨
rain hard 下大雨
It is going to rain this afternoon.
(今天下午會下雨。)
We stayed home because of the heavy rain.
(因為下大雨，我們待在家裡。)

rainbow(n.)彩虹
(無詞性變化)
see a rainbow 看見彩虹
the colors of the rainbow 彩虹的顏色
Look! There is a rainbow in the sky.
(你看！天空中有一道彩虹。)
A rainbow has seven colors.
(彩虹有七種顏色。)

rainy(adj.)下雨的、多雨的
rain(n./v.)雨、下雨
rainy day 雨天
rainy season 雨季
I don't like rainy days.
(我不喜歡下雨天。)
Taipei is often rainy in winter.
(臺北冬天常常下雨。)

raise(v./n.)舉起、提高、養育、加薪
(無詞性變化)
raise your hand 舉手
raise money 募款
Please raise your hand if you know the answer.
(如果你知道答案請舉手。)
She raised three children by herself.
(她獨自養大三個孩子。)

reach(v./n.)到達、伸手拿、聯絡上
(無詞性變化)
reach a goal 達成目標
out of reach 拿不到、搆不著
We reached the station at noon.
(我們中午抵達車站。)
I can't reach the top shelf.
(我搆不到最上層的架子。)

read(v.)讀、閱讀
reader(n.)讀者
reading(n.)閱讀
read a book 看書
read aloud 大聲朗讀
I like to read books before bed.
(我喜歡在睡前看書。)
Can you read this word for me?
(你能幫我念這個字嗎？)

ready(adj./v.)準備好的、樂意的、使準備好
readiness(n.)準備就緒
readily(adv.)樂意地、容易地
get ready 準備好
be ready to 準備好要⋯
Are you ready for the test?
(你準備好考試了嗎？)
Dinner is ready. Let's eat!
(晚餐好了，我們來吃吧！)

real(adj.)真的、真實的
reality(n.)現實
really(adv.)真正地、非常
real life 現實生活
a real friend 真正的朋友
Is this a real diamond?
(這是真的鑽石嗎？)
He is a real friend to me.
(他是我真正的朋友。)

really(adv.)真正地、非常、真的嗎
real(adj.)真的、真實的
really good 非常好
Not really. 不完全是、不太會。
I really like this song.
(我真的很喜歡這首歌。)
The movie was really funny.
(這部電影真的很好笑。)

reason(n./v.)理由、原因、推理
reasonable(adj.)合理的
reasoning(n.)推理
for this reason 因為這個原因
a good reason 好理由
Tell me the reason you were late.
(告訴我你遲到的原因。)
There is no reason to be afraid.
(沒有理由害怕。)

red(adj./n.)紅色的、紅色
(無詞性變化)
red light 紅燈
turn red 變紅、臉紅
She is wearing a red dress today.
(她今天穿著一件紅色洋裝。)
His face turned red with shame.
(他羞得滿臉通紅。)

relative(adj./n.)相對的、親戚
relatively(adv.)相對地
relate(v.)有關聯
close relative 近親
relative to 相對於
We visit our relatives during Chinese New Year.
(我們在農曆新年拜訪親戚。)
My uncle is my only relative in Taipei.
(我叔叔是我在臺北唯一的親戚。)

remember(v.)記得、記住
(無詞性變化)
remember to 記得要⋯
remember + V-ing 記得做過⋯
Remember to bring your umbrella.
(記得帶雨傘。)
I remember meeting her last year.
(我記得去年見過她。)

repeat(v.)重複、重說
repetition(n.)重複
repeated(adj.)重複的、反覆的
repeat after me 跟著我念
repeat a mistake 重蹈覆轍
Please repeat after me.
(請跟著我念。)
Could you repeat the question?
(你可以再說一次問題嗎？)

report(n./v.)報告、報導
reporter(n.)記者
book report 讀書報告
news report 新聞報導
I have to write a book report.
(我必須寫一篇讀書報告。)
The news reported a big fire last night.
(新聞報導了昨晚的一場大火。)

reporter(n.)記者
report(n./v.)報告、報導
news reporter 新聞記者
sports reporter 體育記者
The reporter asked the mayor many questions.
(記者問了市長很多問題。)
She wants to be a news reporter.
(她想當新聞記者。)

rest(n./v.)休息、其餘部分
restful(adj.)寧靜的、使人放鬆的
take a rest 休息一下
the rest of 其餘的⋯
Let's take a rest under the tree.
(我們在樹下休息一下吧。)
I will finish the rest of my homework later.
(我晚點會完成其餘的作業。)

restaurant(n.)餐廳
(無詞性變化)
Chinese restaurant 中式餐廳
fast-food restaurant 速食餐廳
We had dinner at a Chinese restaurant.
(我們在一家中式餐廳吃晚餐。)
This restaurant is very popular.
(這家餐廳非常受歡迎。)

rice(n.)米、米飯、稻
(無詞性變化)
a bowl of rice 一碗飯
fried rice 炒飯
I eat a bowl of rice every day.
(我每天吃一碗飯。)
My mom makes great fried rice.
(我媽媽做的炒飯很好吃。)

rich(adj.)有錢的、富有的、豐富的
richness(n.)豐富
riches(n.)財富
rich in 富含⋯
the rich 有錢人
He became rich after his business grew.
(他的生意擴大後就變得有錢了。)
Oranges are rich in vitamin C.
(柳橙富含維他命C。)

ride(n./v.)騎、搭乘、乘坐
rider(n.)騎士、乘客
ride a bike 騎腳踏車
give someone a ride 載某人一程
I ride my bike to school.
(我騎腳踏車上學。)
Can you give me a ride home?
(你可以載我回家嗎？)

right(adv./adj./n.)正確的、右邊的、權利、立刻
rightly(adv.)正確地、合理地
right now 現在、立刻
turn right 右轉
Your answer is right.
(你的答案是對的。)
Turn right at the next corner.
(在下一個轉角右轉。)

ring(n./v.)戒指、環、鈴聲、(鈴)響、打電話
(無詞性變化)
wedding ring 婚戒
give someone a ring 打電話給某人
The phone is ringing.
(電話在響。)
She wears a gold ring on her finger.
(她手指上戴著一枚金戒指。)

rise(n./v.)上升、升起、增加
rising(adj.)上升的、新興的
rise and fall 起落、興衰
on the rise 正在增加
The sun rises in the east.
(太陽從東方升起。)
Prices are on the rise again.
(物價又在上漲了。)

river(n.)河、江
(無詞性變化)
river bank 河岸
along the river 沿著河
We walked along the river.
(我們沿著河邊散步。)
The river is very wide here.
(這裡的河面非常寬。)

road(n.)路、道路
(無詞性變化)
cross the road 過馬路
on the road 在路上、在旅途中
Be careful when you cross the road.
(過馬路時要小心。)
This road goes to the beach.
(這條路通往海灘。)

robot(n.)機器人
robotic(adj.)機器人的、機械般的
robotics(n.)機器人學
build a robot 製作機器人
robot vacuum 掃地機器人
We built a robot in science class.
(我們在自然課做了一個機器人。)
The robot can clean the floor.
(這台機器人會清潔地板。)

rock(n./v.)岩石、搖滾樂、搖動
rocky(adj.)多岩石的
rock music 搖滾樂
rock the boat 興風作浪
He sat on a big rock by the sea.
(他坐在海邊的一塊大石頭上。)
My brother loves rock music.
(我哥哥熱愛搖滾樂。)

roll(v./n.)滾動、捲、捲狀物、名冊
roller(n.)滾筒、滾輪
roll up 捲起
egg roll 蛋捲
The ball rolled down the hill.
(球滾下了山坡。)
Roll up your sleeves before you wash.
(洗東西前先把袖子捲起來。)

room(n./v.)房間、空間、同住
roommate(n.)室友
roomy(adj.)寬敞的
living room 客廳
make room for 騰出空間給⋯
My room is on the second floor.
(我的房間在二樓。)
There is no room for the piano.
(沒有空間放鋼琴了。)

root(n.)根、根源
(無詞性變化)
root of the problem 問題的根源
take root 生根、紮根
The tree has deep roots.
(這棵樹的根很深。)
Money is not the root of all problems.
(錢不是一切問題的根源。)

rope(n.)繩子
(無詞性變化)
jump rope 跳繩
pull a rope 拉繩子
The kids like to jump rope.
(孩子們喜歡跳繩。)
Hold the rope tightly.
(抓緊繩子。)

rose(n.)玫瑰
rosy(adj.)玫瑰色的、樂觀的
red rose 紅玫瑰
a bunch of roses 一束玫瑰
He gave her a red rose.
(他送給她一朵紅玫瑰。)
These roses smell sweet.
(這些玫瑰聞起來很香。)

round(adj./n./adv./prep./v.)圓的、一回合、環繞、繞過
(無詞性變化)
round trip 來回旅程
all year round 一年到頭
The earth is round.
(地球是圓的。)
You can swim here all year round.
(你一年到頭都可以在這裡游泳。)

row(n./v.)一排、一列、划(船)
(無詞性變化)
in a row 連續地、成一排
front row 前排
We sat in the front row.
(我們坐在前排。)
They rowed the boat across the lake.
(他們划船橫越湖面。)

rule(n./v.)規則、統治
ruler(n.)統治者、尺
follow the rules 遵守規則
break a rule 違反規定
We must follow the school rules.
(我們必須遵守校規。)
The king ruled the country for forty years.
(國王統治這個國家四十年。)

ruler(n.)尺、統治者
rule(n./v.)規則、統治
use a ruler 用尺
wise ruler 賢明的統治者
Draw a line with your ruler.
(用你的尺畫一條線。)
He was a wise ruler.
(他是一位賢明的統治者。)

run(v.)跑、經營、運轉
runner(n.)跑者
running(n.)跑步
run fast 跑得快
run a business 經營事業
He runs very fast.
(他跑得非常快。)
My aunt runs a small shop.
(我阿姨經營一家小店。)
